thread:
anna: Quick post-incident follow-up — incident 2026-03-19 (high model fallbacks). I'd like an updated PRD + guardrail spec so we can lock shipping criteria for routing failover and postmortem runbook edits.

matt: +1. Can you scope this? runtime-only or also console controls (rollout toggles/audit)?

anna: Start runtime guardrails first: 1) per-customer fail-open vs fail-closed policy, 2) automatic downgrade to compatible smaller model variant with latency SLOs, 3) circuit-breaker when error spike > 5% over 5m. Add console controls for forced-routing + audit.

sophie: Add concrete acceptance metrics: error rate after fallback <= 0.5%, p99 latency on degraded path < 450ms, and no cross-customer KV leakage. Need chaos tests for cache invalidation.

dinesh: Drafting operator runbook excerpt for capacity pressure in a region — dropping it here for review.

deploy-bot: deploy check: no infra deploys in last 6h, cluster health OK.

dinesh: ```
# operator-runbook excerpt
1) Identify impacted model pool: GET /internal/pools?region=eu-west
2) Try scale-up: `ci scale pool --id=<id> --type=burst --count=2`
3) If scale fails, enforce forced-routing: PATCH /api/v1/customers/<cust>/routing {"force_variant":"smaller-model"}
4) Monitor errors & traffic: https://console.redwood/observability/routing
5) If quality regressions >1% rollback via: PATCH /api/v1/rollouts/<id> {"state":"paused"}
```

matt: Acceptance criteria for rollout: (a) PRD merged, (b) e2e fallback tests in CI, (c) runbook steps validated in a DR run, (d) guardrail config surfaced in Console with audit logs and RBAC.

anna: Also add soft-launch checklist: enable for 5 pilot customers, 48h monitoring window, automatic rollback threshold triggered on quality/regression signals.

sophie: Edge cases to include in PRD: partial KV cache mismatch when switching variants — we need a cache-compatibility header + eviction policy and upgrade path for persisted KV entries. Tests required.

dinesh: I'll draft the RFC and include a YAML config example for guardrails (policy + thresholds + actions).

anna: Can we have the RFC draft by EOD Friday? Requesting reviewers @matt @sophie. I'll attach the incident postmortem and link the runbook updates there. Thanks everyone.
